description: The four stored resources for notebooks/full_planner.ipynb: the building that produces each one ('mine_building_key'), its warehouse ('warehouse_building_key'), and whether Mining technology (r1) boosts its production.

pig_iron.notes: Direct planetary mine extraction (+2%/lvl r1); feedstock for Blast furnace (2:1)

metal.notes: Smelted 2:1 from Pig iron inside Blast furnace (b2); NOT boosted by r1

kryptonite.notes: Direct planetary mine extraction (+2%/lvl r1); heavy tech & warship input

spice.notes: Temperature-interpolated output (higher on colder colonies) +2%/lvl r1; fleet & scan fuel
